comment.body:
Thanks—the Installed apps entry being absent after 0.102.2933 is clear. The title also mentions a manual-uninstall failure, which the body does not show. Could you please:
- Paste the exact manual uninstall command or installer action you tried and its complete error/code (redact personal folder names); also say whether the original install was for your user or all users, if known. Please do not delete folders or registry keys as a workaround.
- Comment /bugreport and attach the resulting report so the installation/registration context can be matched to that failure. If Settings or the tray cannot be opened, run BugReportTool.exe from the existing PowerToys installation directory.
